answer_1.quote: We propose SPADA, a novel synthesizer that explicitly models feature dependencies while dramatically reducing computational cost, as shown in Figure . Specifically, we treat each feature as a node and use an LLM to extract a relational structure among them to build a directed graph . We then perform a topological traversal  over this graph to sequentially generate feature values.
